name: Jaffna Palmyra Farm
description: Jaffna Palmyra Farm is a serene tea plantation nestled in the lush hills of Northern Sri Lanka, offering visitors a glimpse into the traditional methods of tea cultivation and harvesting. Nestled among the rolling green tea fields, this estate provides a tranquil escape from the bustling city life.

name: Chunnakam Tobacco Farm
description: Chunnakam Tobacco Farm, nestled amidst lush tea plantations, offers visitors a glimpse into the traditional Nallur Kandaswamy Temple, where locals gather for worship and cultural rituals. This serene estate is a perfect spot for nature lovers and history enthusiasts.
activities: Tea plantation tour, temple visit, bird watching
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; check roads after rain

name: Nallur Herb Garden
description: Nallur Herb Garden is a tranquil tea estate in Jaffna, Northern Sri Lanka, known for its lush herb gardens and traditional tea plantation tours. Visitors can explore the beautiful flower beds and learn about the local tea-making process, making it a perfect spot for nature lovers and tea enthusiasts alike.
activities: Learn about tea-making process, Explore herb gardens, Take a guided tour
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; check roads after rain

name: Kopay Spice Walk
description: Discover the rich cultural tapestry and vibrant history at Kopay Spice Walk, a historic tea estate nestled amidst lush greenery and traditional practices. Experience the craftsmanship and learn about the intricate art of tea cultivation in this serene setting.
activities: Explore the tea plantation trails, Learn about traditional tea-making techniques, Visit the local museum
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; check roads after rain

name: Kaithady Botanics
description: Kaithady Botanics, a serene tea estate nestled amidst lush greenery, offers visitors a glimpse into the traditional Nallur Kandaswamy temple and its surrounding botanical gardens, providing a tranquil escape from the bustling city life.
activities: Tea plantation tour, temple visit, nature walk

name: Tellippalai Garden
description: Tellippalai Garden, nestled amidst lush tea plantations, offers visitors a serene retreat where one can immerse themselves in the tranquil beauty of Northern Sri Lanka’s natural landscapes. This estate stands as a testament to the region's rich agricultural heritage, providing a picturesque backdrop for nature lovers and history enthusiasts alike.
activities: Tea plantation tour, bird watching, photography
